corrections.before: Magnate Cafe BTS Jimin Family Area
A cafe known among BTS fans because of its connection to Jimin's family
corrections.after: ZM-ILLENNIAL (지밀레니얼) is a cafe in Daeyeon-dong, Nam-gu, Busan, run by the father of BTS's Jimin. It opened in 2019 as MAGNATE and was renamed ZM-ILLENNIAL in 2024. It serves coffee, bread and desserts, and fans from around the world visit around Jimin's birthday.

after.ko: 지밀레니얼(ZM-ILLENNIAL)은 부산 남구 대연동에 있는 카페로, BTS 지민의 아버지가 운영합니다. 2019년 MAGNATE(메그네이트)라는 이름으로 문을 열었고 2024년 지밀레니얼로 바꿨습니다. 커피와 빵·디저트를 팔며, 지민 생일 무렵에는 전 세계 팬들이 찾아옵니다.
after.en: ZM-ILLENNIAL (지밀레니얼) is a cafe in Daeyeon-dong, Nam-gu, Busan, run by the father of BTS's Jimin. It opened in 2019 as MAGNATE and was renamed ZM-ILLENNIAL in 2024. It serves coffee, bread and desserts, and fans from around the world visit around Jimin's birthday.
after.ja: ZM-ILLENNIAL(ジミレニアル)は釜山・南区大淵洞にあるカフェで、BTSジミンの父が営んでいます。2019年にMAGNATEとして開業し、2024年にZM-ILLENNIALへ改名しました。コーヒーとパン・デザートを提供し、ジミンの誕生日の頃には世界中のファンが訪れます。
after.zh: ZM-ILLENNIAL（지밀레니얼）是位于釜山南区大渊洞的咖啡馆，由BTS智旻的父亲经营。2019年以MAGNATE之名开业，2024年更名为ZM-ILLENNIAL。店内供应咖啡、面包和甜点，智旻生日前后会有来自世界各地的粉丝到访。
